title: Modified Protocol to Improve Bodo Saltans Yield in Culture
author: Zhu-Hong Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9vyh67w

steps.title: Prepare Bodo saltans medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the bacteria-Bodo saltans medium according to the specified protocol (https://www.protocols.io/view/bodo-saltans-culture-protocol-sh6eb9e).

steps.title: Collect and wash Bodo cells
steps.instruction: Collect Bodo cells from a T25 tissue culture flask and wash them to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 1200 x g for 6 minutes.
Resuspend pelleted cells in deionized water.
Resuspend the cells in culture medium.

steps.title: Inoculate T25 culture flask
steps.instruction: Inoculate a T25 tissue culture flask (50 ml) containing 10 to 15 ml of fresh medium supplemented with 10 mg/ml puromycin.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 ml-0.5 ml of cells from the previous collection step into the flask.
Incubate the flask horizontally at 18C with a loosely adjusted cap.

steps.title: Harvest Bodo cells
steps.instruction: Collect and wash the cells for downstream applications after 2-4 days, once the Bodo cell density reaches approximately 3 X 10^6/ml.
